articles.title: Movement Labs files for Chapter 11 bankruptcy months after token scandal
articles.snippet: The filing comes after months of upheaval that included a controversial market-making agreement, an internal investigation into its MOVE token launch and a Binance ban tied to its market maker.

articles.title: MoneyGram's CEO says blockchain works best when customers don't know it's there
articles.snippet: In an interview with CoinDesk, MoneyGram CEO Anthony Soohoo said that their blockchain strategy has evolved from early experimentation into a broader effort to modernize the company's global payments infrastructure.

articles.title: Bitcoin hits one-month high above $66,000 as the chip trade turns back into a tailwind
articles.snippet: Asian semiconductor shares rebounded hard, a five-day ETF inflow streak passed $600 million, and oil pulled back on Middle East diplomacy.

articles.title: Exodus to cut 25% of global workforce in payments shift
articles.snippet: This restructuring is part of a strategy to build a full-stack payments platform following the company's acquisitions of Monavate and Baanx.

articles.title: BIS warns stablecoins could weaken capital controls in emerging markets
articles.snippet: Researchers found dollar-backed stablecoins are less affected by capital controls than traditional bank deposits, raising new questions about monetary sovereignty in emerging markets.
